what_it_is: The common feed state delivered to the ionization/discharge block (valve outlet, ICD IF-A5; Xe port IF-X2) per altitude and atmosphere level, plus the orbit-averaged free-stream state that feeds the chain (ICD IF-A0), with producer, evidence class and uncertainty per value.
what_it_is_not: Not a design, not a Hall prediction, not an architecture ranking, not a model change: no module is modified or wired, no frozen dataset is rebuilt, and no value depends on a Hall transport closure, an ensemble member or a P5 calibration-nuisance variable.

milestones.statement: Supports milestone A (conditional selection): it fixes ONE architecture-independent feed definition at the thruster boundary (IF-A5 / IF-X2) and the orbit-averaged free-stream envelope over 180/200/230 km x low/mean/high from the frozen NRLMSIS 2.1 dataset, so that 'architecture X is baseline provided ...' conditions can be written against identical feed conditions and the named design inputs. It does not need Physics Baseline 1.0 and contains no Hall prediction.
to_reach_B: a documented Vyovrinda design baseline with provenance for every design input in design_input_contract, so the valve-outlet feed state (mdot, p, T, x_s) is evaluated instead of TBD
upstream convergence reporting in the modules (ICD G-03, G-04, G-05); this script only checks residuals from outside
a decision on the collected-flow composition convention (ICD G-02) and on gas-temperature propagation (ICD G-07)
an NRLMSIS 2.1 error characterisation (no uncertainty is exposed today) and orbit-resolved extremes from a frozen orbit-resolved dataset (rebuild under CLAUDE.md rule 1)
on the Hall side (other track): an admitted Hall transport closure; the feed state here is what its design Hall maps would be queried with
to_reach_C: a Xe storage / regulator / valve model and a Xe flow-setpoint policy (ICD G-12)
feed dynamics for start-up and throttling (ICD G-09), filter model (ICD G-01), contamination transport (ICD G-11)
integration of the chain's mass, power and heat (compressor heat split ICD G-17) into the PDR budgets

architectures.common_feed_rule: All three architectures receive the identical feed record for a given case. The RF/ECR arms change only the pre-ionization method, which is downstream of IF-A5; no field is keyed by, parameterised by or produced for an architecture id.

added_fields: xe_path.feed_state.w_s / x_s (ICD IF-X2 has xe_purity, a gap, instead)
interface_alignment.quantity_shape: ICD scalar_quantity / species_quantity (value|values, unit, evidence_class, uncertainty, source, validity_domain, in_domain) plus 'producer' and, for TBD values, 'requires' / 'requires_design_inputs'. Drop those keys to form an ICD record.
interface_alignment.composition_basis: w_s = mass fraction, x_s = mole fraction (flow basis at IF-A5)

input_files.role: frozen NRLMSIS 2.1 scenario values (every free-stream number)
frozen atmosphere metadata (grid, ap, epoch, sha256_16)
frozen TPMC response surface (design-conditional chain only)
frozen TPMC surface metadata (grid bounds, n_per_point, max_unresolved)

files_read.role: read only (ast): Config defaults and the gas-path chaining mirrored in run_chain()
read only (ast): PRIORS['accommodation'] (the only upstream uncertainty prior in code)
historical reference values quoted in `not_adopted` (token-checked by the test)

frozen_atmosphere.averaging: lat -60..60 (7) x lon 0..270 (4) at fixed UT
frozen_atmosphere.species_dropped: He, H, Ar, N (<2 % by mass at 180-230 km); rho includes them

provenance.chain_mirrored: abep_sim/archengine.py:gas_path_state -> abep_sim/system.py:evaluate (gaspath_physics=True): atmosphere -> intake.collection (TPMC) -> intake.compress (passive plenum) -> compressor.DragCompressor.size_for/run -> reservoir.Reservoir + size_orifice_for_pressure -> Reservoir.steady_state (mdot_anode, p_total_Pa, T_K, composition_anode_mass)

validity_domains.D-ATM-FROZEN: Frozen NRLMSIS 2.1 scenario dataset abep_sim/data/atmosphere_msis21_v1.{csv,json}: altitude 150-300 km (2 km grid), F10.7 = F10.7A in {70, 100, 150, 190, 230}, ap 15, orbit-averaged (lat -60..60 x lon 0..270 at fixed UT), epoch 2028-03-21T12:00, species O/N2/O2 only (He, H, Ar, N dropped per the dataset metadata: '<2 % by mass at 180-230 km; rho includes them': verify). ICD id reused (schemas/interfaces/upstream_icd_v1.json).
validity_domains.D-ORBIT-CIRCULAR: Circular Keplerian orbital speed sqrt(MU_EARTH / (R_EARTH + h)) with constants.py values (spherical Earth radius 6371 km). Relative speed (co-rotation, winds) is not produced on the frozen path (ICD G-10).
validity_domains.D-TPMC-FROZEN: Frozen TPMC response surface abep_sim/data/intake_surface_v1.{csv,json}: grid in the metadata (L/d, phi, alpha, theta), species O/N2/O2, scattering maxwell|cll, built at 200 km, F10.7 150, orbit-averaged. IntakeSurface raises outside the grid; this script refuses out-of-grid inputs before intake.collection() can clamp them. ICD id reused.
validity_domains.D-DRAGCOMP: compressor.DragCompressor (free-molecular turbo rows + Holweck/Gaede drag stages). ICD id reused.
validity_domains.D-RESERVOIR: reservoir.Reservoir (isothermal lumped volume, O/O2/N2, molecular-flow orifice, O wall recombination gamma(T) from materials.DB). ICD id reused.
validity_domains.D-DESIGN-TBD: No design baseline with provenance: the quantity is TBD until the named design inputs are supplied.
validity_domains.D-XE-TBD: No Xe storage / regulator / valve model in the repository (ICD G-12).

atmosphere_levels.source: abep_sim/atmosphere.py _SOLAR_F107 (low/mean/high -> F10.7 70/150/230; module docstring 'F10.7 ~ 70 / 150 / 230'); F10.7A = F10.7 and ap from the frozen dataset metadata
atmosphere_levels.note: The level labels are a repository convention with no external source cited in the repository (verify against the mission solar-cycle specification). Each level is an exact node of the frozen F10.7 grid, so no F10.7 interpolation is involved (the grid also holds F10.7 100 and 190, which no level uses). Geomagnetic activity: only ap = 15 is in the frozen dataset (no storm levels). Single epoch (equinox), so seasonal variation is not covered.

extremes.requires: TBD - requires a frozen orbit-resolved NRLMSIS dataset (built under CLAUDE.md rule 1). The frozen dataset is orbit-averaged by construction; abep_sim/orbit_atm.orbit_atmosphere computes along-track min/max only with live pymsis, which the frozen chain does not use (CLAUDE.md rule 3)
extremes.covered_here: orbit-averaged states only (averaging = 'orbit_averaged' in every case)

design_inputs.note: no design-input file supplied: the repository documents no design baseline with provenance for the chain's design inputs (see not_adopted)

design_input_contract.name: intake.area_m2
design_input_contract.consumer: abep_sim.intake.IntakeParams.area_m2 -> abep_sim.intake.collection (mdot_collected = eta_c x flux_kg_m2_s x area_m2)
design_input_contract.description: ram capture area of the intake

design_input_contract.name: intake.accommodation
design_input_contract.description: gas-surface accommodation (surface state; 0 specular .. 1 diffuse). Physically an uncertain surface property (epistemic prior in abep_sim/uq_modular.py PRIORS['accommodation']), supplied here as an explicit input
design_input_contract.note: intake.collection() clamps accommodation to [0, 1] before the ROM bounds check; this script refuses values outside the surface grid instead

design_input_contract.name: intake.off_axis_deg
design_input_contract.description: intake pointing error (angle of attack of the ram flow)
design_input_contract.note: intake.collection() silently clamps off_axis_deg to <= 5 deg; this script refuses values outside the surface grid instead

design_input_contract.name: intake.scattering
design_input_contract.description: gas-surface scattering kernel of the frozen surface

design_input_contract.name: plenum.T_gas_K
design_input_contract.consumer: abep_sim.intake.CompressorParams.T_out_K -> intake.compress (p_passive_Pa = n x CR_passive x k_B x T)
design_input_contract.description: gas temperature of the passively compressed plenum
design_input_contract.note: the frozen TPMC CR_passive was computed with the IntakeGeometry wall temperature, a separate parameter (ICD G-07); the surface metadata does not record it: verify

design_input_contract.name: plenum.backflow_frac
design_input_contract.description: fraction of the collected flow lost to leakage/backflow before the compressor

design_input_contract.name: compressor.mode
design_input_contract.description: fixed = the compressor design is given (turbo_rows, n_stages, rpm); size_for = searched as system.evaluate does, for the valve pressure setpoint
design_input_contract.note: the parametric total compression ratio (intake.CompressorParams.ratio) is not an input of the gas-path-physics chain mirrored here: system.evaluate overrides its p_out, and the active compression ratio is a compressor output (CR_active)

design_input_contract.name: compressor.turbo_rows
design_input_contract.note: output of size_for (must not be supplied in size_for mode)

design_input_contract.name: compressor.turbo_area_m2
design_input_contract.note: system.evaluate overrides it with min(0.45, 0.9 x intake area x phi)

design_input_contract.name: compressor.turbo_radius_m
design_input_contract.note: system.evaluate overrides it with min(0.45, sqrt(intake area / pi))

design_input_contract.name: compressor.n_stages
design_input_contract.note: output of size_for (must not be supplied in size_for mode)

design_input_contract.name: compressor.rpm
design_input_contract.note: output of size_for (must not be supplied in size_for mode)

design_input_contract.name: compressor.size_for.rpm_max
design_input_contract.description: upper rpm bound of the size_for search (further capped by the rotor stress limit)
design_input_contract.note: size_for also hard-codes its objective (mass + 0.02 x electrical power) and a 2500 rpm search step

design_input_contract.name: compressor.size_for.max_turbo_rows
design_input_contract.note: size_for also hard-codes its objective (mass + 0.02 x electrical power) and a 2500 rpm search step

design_input_contract.name: compressor.size_for.max_drag_stages
design_input_contract.note: size_for also hard-codes its objective (mass + 0.02 x electrical power) and a 2500 rpm search step

design_input_contract.name: chamber.volume_m3
design_input_contract.description: atmospheric gas chamber (buffer) volume; sets inventory and residence time, not the steady feed state

design_input_contract.name: chamber.T_K
design_input_contract.description: chamber gas temperature (= delivered gas temperature). Token 'system_evaluate_compressor_machine_T_clamped_300_500K' applies the system.evaluate convention min(max(T_comp_K, 300), 500)

design_input_contract.name: chamber.anode_orifice_K
design_input_contract.description: Clausing factor of the lumped valve + feed-line + anode-distributor restriction (ICD G-06)

design_input_contract.name: chamber.upstream_collisions
design_input_contract.description: O wall collisions inside the compressor. Token 'system_evaluate_heuristic_10_per_turbo_row_plus_50_per_drag_stage' applies the system.evaluate heuristic (no cited source; ICD G-16)

design_input_contract.name: chamber.upstream_material
design_input_contract.description: compressor wall material for upstream O recombination
design_input_contract.note: system.evaluate derives it from the rotor material (Ti6Al4V/Al6061 kept, anything else -> Al2O3_anodised)

design_input_contract.name: valve.mode
design_input_contract.consumer: run_chain(): size_orifice_for_pressure (pressure_setpoint) or a given orifice area (orifice_area)
design_input_contract.description: how the valve setting is specified
design_input_contract.note: compressor.mode == size_for requires valve.mode == pressure_setpoint (the size_for target)

design_input_contract.name: valve.p_feed_setpoint_Pa
design_input_contract.note: system.evaluate uses Config.p_margin_over_pmin (3.0, dataclass default) x the thruster card p_min, which is architecture-dependent and a card prior (thruster.py); no architecture-neutral value is documented (see not_adopted)

design_input_contract.name: valve.anode_orifice_area_m2
design_input_contract.description: open area of the lumped valve / feed restriction (valve setting)

status_reasons: no documented design baseline with provenance (see design_input_contract and not_adopted)

chain_findings.finding: off_axis_deg is clamped to <= 5 deg and accommodation to [0, 1] before the frozen-surface bounds check, so an out-of-grid pointing error is silently evaluated at 5 deg
the chamber-pressure target is capped at the compressor outlet, min(p_target, p_out), without a flag
chain_findings.handling: a setpoint above the compressor outlet gives status INFEASIBLE with null feed values

chain_findings.finding: returns the bracket end [1e-8, 3e-2] m^2 without a flag when the setpoint is unreachable
chain_findings.handling: bracket hit is detected and reported; status MODEL_ERROR
the script recomputes the recirculation fixed-point residual and the chamber mass-balance residual against each module's own stopping tolerance; failure gives MODEL_ERROR

chain_findings.finding: the collected flow is split by free-stream mass fractions although the frozen surface is species-resolved
chain_findings.handling: both conventions are evaluated; the chain convention is primary, the species-resolved one is carried as a scenario in every feed-state uncertainty

chain_findings.finding: the cache key omits the ABEP_ALLOW_TABLE_ATMOSPHERE environment switch (ABEP_ATMOSPHERE enters only through the resolved use_msis flag), so a table-fallback state cached with the switch set is returned later without it, and vice versa (CLAUDE.md rule 5: caches must be pure functions of their keys)
chain_findings.handling: every call's returned `source` is checked against the frozen dataset hash and the value against the CSV grid node; anything else raises FrozenAtmosphereRequired

chain_findings.finding: two unrelated temperatures: plenum T_out_K for p_passive and the TPMC wall temperature of the frozen surface build for CR_passive (not recorded in the surface metadata: verify)
chain_findings.handling: plenum.T_gas_K is an explicit design input; the inconsistency is listed, not resolved

chain_findings.finding: the frozen TPMC surface was built at 200 km / F10.7 150 only; the docstring says eta_c, C_D and K_back depend on the speed ratio through sqrt(T/m), 'which varies < 10 % across 180-230 km and the solar cycle' (no cited source). The frozen free-stream states of this envelope give a larger spread of sqrt(T/m_mean) relative to the build point (exposed_uncertainty, computed here)
chain_findings.handling: recorded under exposed_uncertainty with the computed spread; the effect on eta_c is not quantified or propagated (TBD - requires TPMC surfaces at the other atmospheric states)
